comment: Opt-in registry of repo-VERSION (Series 1) coupled locations. scripts/ci/check-drift.mjs enforces that every live slot captures exactly the current VERSION (json_path dot-paths support at most one '*' array segment; regex slots must match >= 1 time with capture group 1 and ALL captures equal VERSION). Series 2 (per-skill semver: skills.json, SKILL.md metadata.version, CHANGELOG '### <skill> <x.y.z>' lines) is governed by check-drift's per-skill structural checks and NEVER appears here. Two version series never share a mechanism. There is deliberately NO repository-wide version scan: adding a new Series-1 version mention requires registering a slot here in the same PR (see AGENTS.md + .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md). Series-1 mentions that are intentionally historical (CHANGELOG sections, README/docs prose) need no registration because nothing scans them.

live_slots.notes: every plugins[] entry must carry the current version; a missing version key fails
